heading: Develop package card final design & Status card system

blocks.html: After finalizing the card and list layout through iterative design processes, I improved the UI by incorporating the brand color and colored tags for drivers to differentiate easily. I refined it through usability testing, making adjustments based on valuable feedback. A comprehensive status card system was finally developed for various delivery results.
